title: Rams hold a top-15 pick for first time since 2016. Will they draft a receiver?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams hold a top-15 pick for first time since 2016. Will they draft a receiver?
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay is excited about possibly adding a "really good player" with the No. 13 pick of the 2026 NFL draft, but the team is keeping its options open.
